page_title: ATM 1-0 SEV | Atletico Madrid v Sevilla 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90+1' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90+1' Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
90' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

90' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
88' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jan Oblak, who smothers the ball.
87' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
85' A yellow card for bad language! Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
83' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' Here is a change. Adria Pedrosa is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
82' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
79' The free kick will be taken by Sergio Ramos (Sevilla).
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Oliver Torres will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
77' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
77' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
77' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
77' 10:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
73' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) replaces Antoine Griezmann.
71' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) has to leave the pitch!

70' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid), but referee Cesar Soto Grado must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
70' Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
68' Yellow card. Kike Salas (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
68' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
67' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) and Marcos Llorente combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
66' Substitution. Koke makes way for Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid).
66' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post!
64' It will be a corner kick for Sevilla.
64' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
62' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kike Salas (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
59' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
58' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
56' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
55' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Substitution. Alvaro Morata walks off the pitch and Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
53' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Ivan Rakitic is replaced by Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
53' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Suso as he is replaced by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla).
53' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
52' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
46' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Nahuel Molina will be replaced by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
46' Half-time substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Angel Correa.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Kike Salas (Sevilla) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
45' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
43' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Suso (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
42' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
41' A lofted cross from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' A long pass, executed by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
37' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) finds Samuel Lino with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
36' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
35' The free kick from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
34' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
33' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
25' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) switches the play to Alvaro Morata and their attacking move continues.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
22' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
22' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
21' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
14' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
13' The ball is cleared after Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
9' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' He should have scored! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
4' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) will take the free kick.
4' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Lovely run from Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
2' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla), but the defence gets it clear.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
